assumptions: A browser and cURL are available.

developer_goal: Create a Gemini API key and receive text from the Interactions REST API.

first_success.outcome: An authenticated Gemini Interactions request returns model-generated text.
first_success.observable_signal: The response has status completed and a model_output text step.

route_selection.rule: Prefer the current first-party REST quickstart and include all required account and credential gates.

candidates.name: Interactions REST API
candidates.reason: The route is documented, but free-tier eligibility, identity, fields, and atomic event evidence still require independent review.

platform_outcomes.description: The Interactions API returns model output text.

sources.title: Getting started with the Gemini API

uncertainties.question: Does every new supported account have usable free-tier quota and the same required signup fields?
uncertainties.impact: Could add billing or identity gates.
uncertainties.evidence_needed: Independent current account walkthrough and source capture.
